title: Daycare Incident Report Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=daycare:incident
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by incident_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when daycare incident report data has stopped arriving for a given incident type.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per incident type and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers when one part of your daycare incident report feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
